name: Meteotrentino station list
what: Metadata of automatic weather stations (code, name, altitude, coordinates)
notes: XML. Field names partly inconsistent (UTM fields swapped, per MeteoDataTrentino R package)

name: Meteotrentino snow fields list
what: Metadata of manual snow fields, incl. Vermiglio (Capanna Presena) 2715 m
notes: Snow depth, new snow; winter season only

name: Meteotrentino recent station data
what: Latest values per station (temperature, precipitation, radiation where measured)
notes: Recent only. For past summers use the historical archive (W04)

name: Meteotrentino historical station series
notes: Find the download page for historical data; identify stations near Tonale/Presena with shortwave radiation

name: meteo.report (Euregio)
what: Common map and API access to Trentino and Alto Adige stations
licence: CC BY 4.0 for Trentino and Alto Adige data
notes: Tirol data reserved

name: MeteoSwiss automatic weather stations (SwissMetNet)
what: All parameters per station, now / recent / historical files; station, parameter and inventory metadata
notes: Semicolon CSV, UTC, dd.mm.yyyy HH:MM. Samedan, Corvatsch for Morteratsch/Diavolezza. Download the granularity you need, don't aggregate 10-min yourself

name: ARPA Lombardia station data
what: Meteorological sensor data (Ponte di Legno, Passo Tonale side)
notes: Lombardy side of the pass; useful cross-check

name: University of Milan AWS on the Presena cover (2010, 2012)
provider: Università degli Studi di Milano (Diolaiuti, Senese)
what: Energy-balance station data on fleece and on bare ice
notes: Best source for real albedo and radiation values on the patch

name: ERA5-Land hourly
notes: Also in Google Earth Engine as ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY. 9 km cell ≠ glacier surface: use for gaps and context, state the limit

name: Sentinel-2 L2A
notes: Also GEE: COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED. Visibility test, cover extent per year

name: Copernicus Browser
what: Visual browsing, custom band composites, permalinks to scenes
notes: Save a permalink for every scene you use, in the evidence log

name: Copernicus High Resolution Snow & Ice
what: Fractional snow cover, wet/dry snow, ice
notes: Context, not the patch itself

name: Landsat Collection 2 Level 2
notes: GEE: LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2 etc. Long view of retreat, too coarse for the cover

name: Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 (HLS)
notes: Denser time series at 30 m

name: MODIS albedo MCD43A3
notes: Regional comparison only

name: SPOT World Heritage
what: Orthorectified SPOT 1–5 multispectral, older than 5 years
notes: Extent 2008–2015

name: ESA SPOT 1–5 archive
licence: free for ESA member-state users, ESA terms
notes: Request reviewed by ESA, about 2 days. SPOT 5 pan is the best free pre-2015 option

name: Planet (PlanetScope, RapidEye archive)
what: Daily 3 m imagery; RapidEye 5 m archive
notes: Check E&R eligibility. Images can't be republished, only derived results

name: Google Earth Pro historical imagery
notes: Use for quick checks and dating; log date and provider; don't publish screenshots

name: Trentino LiDAR 2006–2009
notes: Find the Presena tile and its flight date: before summer 2008 = pre-cover baseline

name: Trentino LiDAR PAT 2014 + 2018 flights
what: DTM, DSM first/last, DBM (.asc, .xyz) and raw point cloud (.laz)
notes: Core comparison for the plinth test

name: Trentino LiDAR tile index 2014/2018
provider: Provincia autonoma di Trento – Servizio Geologico
notes: Use first to find which tiles cover Presena

name: TanDEM-X 90 m DEM
notes: Too coarse for the patch; context

name: TanDEM-X 30 m Edited DEM and DEM Change Maps
what: Edited DEM and change maps for data since 2016
notes: About 85 pixels on the 2010 patch

name: TanDEM-X 12 m DEM
notes: Slow; later phase

name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
notes: Base terrain for maps and monoplotting

name: SRTM
notes: Pre-cover reference; C-band penetrates snow and firn

name: swissALTI3D / swissSURFACE3D
notes: Diavolezza comparison

name: Sentinel-1 GRD/SLC
notes: Wet snow and melt timing; fleece signature is a hypothesis. GEE: COPERNICUS/S1_GRD

name: NISAR L-band
notes: One season only; curiosity

name: ICESat-2 ATL06
notes: Check whether a track crosses Presena

name: Trentino orthophoto 2015
notes: Check flight date: in summer the cover is unmistakable

name: Trentino geoportal and WMS services
what: Orthophotos of other years, technical map, glaciers layer
notes: List which orthophoto years exist over Presena

name: CTP 2000 topographic layer (glaciers and snowfields)
what: Built-up areas, glaciers and snowfields at 1:10,000
notes: Pre-cover glacier outline

name: Geoportale Lombardia
what: Orthophotos, DTM, base maps (Tonale/Ponte di Legno side)

name: swisstopo LUBIS aerial images
notes: Diavolezza/Morteratsch history

name: OpenStreetMap
what: Lifts, pistes, huts, paths, rivers, borders
notes: Base layers for the Situate map; ODbL is share-alike for the database

name: Randolph Glacier Inventory 7.0
notes: Glacier geometry

name: GLIMS glacier database
notes: Look for repeated outlines of Presena

name: GLAMOS
notes: Retreat timeline for Morteratsch

name: WGMS Fluctuations of Glaciers database
notes: Check if Presena has mass-balance or length series

name: Comitato Glaciologico Italiano: campaigns and photo archive
what: Annual campaign reports with photos since 1969
notes: Late-summer photos of Presena may show the cover

name: SAT Commissione Glaciologica
what: Field surveys and repeat photos of Trentino glaciers
notes: Published a 1916–2021 Presena comparison

name: Operator webcam 'Presena 3000'
what: Live still image near Cima Presena (~3000 m), timestamp overlay
time_coverage: live only; no public archive found on operator site
notes: Served as a live JPEG with an access token (do not publish the token). Summer frames would date laying/removal; consider a daily capture from June 2027, with the operator's permission

name: Flickr API
what: Geotagged photos with EXIF date taken and licence
notes: Store metadata and links only

name: Wikimedia Commons API
notes: Easiest to republish

name: YouTube Data API v3
what: Videos by place and date (summer skiing, drones)
notes: Drone videos as possible SfM input

name: ETH-Bibliothek E-Pics Bildarchiv
what: Historical photos, many CC BY-SA 4.0 or public domain
notes: Morteratsch

name: SwissEduc glacier repeat photos
what: Repeat photo pairs with stated credits

name: Natura 2000 site data
what: Standard data forms; candidate site covering Presena: IT3120158 Adamello Presanella (ZPS)
notes: Confirm which site boundary (ZPS/ZSC) contains the covered patch

name: Provincial acts (delibere) and press releases
what: Funding and authorisations for ski areas and glacier protection
notes: Search by Presena, Carosello Tonale, teli geotessili

name: Operator page on Presena protection
notes: Main source of claims C01, C04, C07–C14. Capture by hand (SingleFile/PDF/Wayback); check older Wayback versions

name: Senese et al. 2020
what: Up to 69% less melt, albedo values
notes: DOI 10.1016/j.coldregions.2020.103007 (Cold Regions Science and Technology). Model calibration

name: Huss et al., EGU 2022
what: Swiss covers: 0.18 km², up to 350,000 m³/yr
notes: DOI 10.5194/egusphere-egu22-1808

name: Annali MEMOTEF, Presena case study
what: Geotextile covers at Presena since 2008 as mitigation
notes: Find the stable article page

name: Panomax 'Passo Tonale' and 'Ponte di Legno'
notes: Check in the full 360° whether the Presena glacier is in view (south of the pass); the default frame looks at the opposite slope

name: Windy webcam 'Vermiglio: Ghiacciaio Presena'
notes: Possibly a different camera from the operator's 'Presena 3000'; check whether it keeps a timelapse or archive

name: MUSE 2021 study on the future of the Presena glacier
what: Glacier evolution under SSP scenarios, covered vs uncovered
notes: Cited on the operator page (claim C14). Find the report itself; ask MUSE
